about_the_game:
In Core Miners, you’ll step into the role of a mine manager, leading a team of miners from the earth’s surface all the way down to the deep underground. Every level is filled with abundant ores and unknown treasures waiting for you to unearth—rare ores even let you strike it rich overnight! There’s no need to stay glued to the screen: the game supports offline earnings. The longer you’re offline, the harder your miners work, and the more gold they accumulate for you. When you return, you’ll be greeted with a pleasant surprise, truly enabling effortless AFK (away-from-keyboard) play and continuous progress.

As you dig deeper into the mine, new miners and mysterious ores will unlock one after another, bringing fresh strategies and fun. Unlock powerful equipment, upgrade your miner team, and build your very own mining empire!

Dig infinitely deep, with surprises at every level—rare ores are waiting for you to mine!

AFK offline, harvest easily, and say goodbye to grind-heavy gameplay!

Diverse miners with unique skills—you’re in control of their strategic combinations!

Easy to pick up and play, for the ultimate relaxing mining experience!

Download the game now and embark on your legendary mining journey!
